prose: Reuters reports Microsoft's quarterly results: capex of $45.2 billion, up from $34.9 billion a year earlier but below the company's own $50 billion projection, and free cash flow of $18.6 billion against an $8.54 billion analyst estimate. Quarterly cloud revenue beat expectations, signaling the hefty AI investments are landing.
